g1.flow: The warning comes twice, back to back. First plain: kallā sawfa taʿlamūn, right after 'until you visit the graveyards'. Then again with thumma ('then') added in front. Hook: thumma means 'then', so it can only be the second one. After it, a third 'No!' changes course: 'If you only knew with knowledge of certainty'.

cues.102:3: Plain kallā, no thumma: right after 'until you visit the graveyards'.
cues.102:4: Thumma kallā: the repeat; next, 'No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty'.
